scripts.build:webext:dev: npm run clean:webext && webpack --mode development --config webpackExtension.config.js
scripts.build:webext:prod: npm run clean:webext && webpack --mode production --config webpackExtension.config.js
scripts.build:webext:dev:watch: npm run clean:webext && webpack --mode development --config webpackExtension.config.js --watch
scripts.build:webext:prod:watch: npm run clean:webext && webpack --mode production --config webpackExtension.config.js --watch
scripts.build:dev: npm run clean:dist && webpack --mode development --config webpack.config.js
scripts.build:dev:watch: npm run clean:dist && webpack --mode development --config webpack.config.js --watch
scripts.build:prod: npm run clean:dist && webpack --mode production --config webpack.config.js
scripts.build:prod:watch: npm run clean:dist && webpack --mode production --config webpack.config.js --watch
scripts.clean: npm run clean:dist && npm run clean:browsers && npm run clean:webext
scripts.playwright:test:dev: npm run build:webext:dev && npm run build:dev && playwright test
scripts.playwright:test:prod: npm run build:webext:prod && npm run build:prod && playwright test
scripts.playwright:test-ui:dev: npm run build:webext:dev && npm run build:dev && playwright test --ui
scripts.playwright:test-ui:prod: npm run build:webext:prod && npm run build:prod && playwright test --ui
